item.title: Checker Bar reopens in Detroit's Cadillac Square after fire forced closure
item.description: A legendary spot in the heart of Detroit is ready for its comeback. Checker Bar in Cadillac Square reopens Wednesday.

item.title: Michigan couple living in Israel share experiences amid conflict with Iran
item.description: Hannan Lis and his wife, Lisa's, roots are in Michigan. But he said they moved to Tel Aviv, Israel's capital, during COVID to be closer to their kids and grandkids.

item.title: Dittrich Furs restocks shelves for sale on Friday
item.description: It may be your last shot to own a piece of Detroit history. Dittrich Furs is putting more coats on the shelves after the first round of closing sales emptied the racks.
